title: Any auto-battler or PvP fans here? Academy Wars is now available for playtesting on Steam!
author: MrRoadForward
selftext:
Against all advice, I went ahead and developed a live-service PvP auto-battler as my first game.  
  
**Academy Wars** is a 1v1 PvP auto-battler where you draft students, build them with stats, then outplay your opponents through positioning, adaptation, and strategic thinking.

The Steam Playtest is now open for access requests! I'd love for you guys to give it a try, compete against other players through global matchmaking, or take the challenge against the VS AI mode.

**Steam:** [**https://store.steampowered.com/app/4821370/Academy\_Wars/#**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4821370/Academy_Wars/#)

**AI stack:** Gpt 5.6 Terra - 6.1 Sol, Opus 5.5, Deepseek 4.1,  ElevenLabs, Tripo/Rodin AI,

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/MrRoadForward please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.
